description: This file declares structures and function prototypes related to IEEE 802.11v WNM (Wireless Network Management) and RRM (Radio Resource Management) functions within a Wi-Fi hardware abstraction layer. It includes function handlers for WNM action frames, RRM action frames, and communication with BSS Transition Management (BTM).

methods.name: handle_wnm_action_frame
methods.description: Handles WNM action frames received from clients, including processing of management frames.

methods.name: handle_rrm_action_frame
methods.description: Handles RRM (Radio Resource Management) action frames, processing radio measurement requests or reports.

methods.name: wifi_rrm_send_beacon_req
methods.description: Sends a Beacon Request for radio measurement purposes, supporting parameters like channel, mode, intervals, and request elements.

methods.name: wifi_wnm_send_bss_tm_req
methods.description: Sends a BSS Transition Management Request to a station, including various parameters such as disassociation timer, neighbor reports, and MBO attributes.
